title: Sequence-length cascade bucketer with kernel hinting and prefill-aware packer
creator: Priya Shah
description: Design and implement a cascade bucketing system that groups requests by dynamic sequence-length bands, emits per-bucket kernel-hint metadata for downstream scheduler/kernel selection, and performs prefill-aware packing to minimize padding while preserving tail-latency SLOs. Goal is to reduce pad-token overhead across mixed workloads and enable more deterministic kernel paths for low-latency requests.
acceptance_criteria: Average padding tokens per request reduced by >= 20% on internal mixed workload benchmark
99th-percentile latency does not increase by more than 5% compared to baseline for P99-sensitive lanes
Kernel hint metadata integrated into request envelope and respected by the kernel selector for at least A100/H100 paths
End-to-end telemetry (pad tokens, bucket sizes, kernel choices, per-bucket latency) visible in Console dashboards
Canary rollout plan validated and automated rollback trigger defined
implementation_notes: Bucketization: compute dynamic cascade thresholds from running histogram of sequence-lengths (exponential backoff tiers + entropy smoothing)
Prefill-aware packer: prefer coalescing requests with similar prefill vs decode ratios to avoid KV cache churn; allow partial fill merges when prefill dominates
Kernel hints: emit lightweight hint tags (e.g., kernel_hint: 'low-latency', 'high-batch', 'quantized') per-bucket; ensure hints are advisory and fall back to compatibility mapping
Routing: expose bucket id and kernel_hint to smart router so latency-sensitive buckets can be steered to hot paths or dedup pools
Memory: maintain per-bucket temporary workspace; enforce hard caps to protect host from traffic spikes
Compatibility: preserve existing API/SDK contract; internal wiring only (no customer-visible changes)
testing_plan: Unit tests for bucket assignment and threshold adaptation (edge cases: streaming, flush),
Synthetic perf harness comparing baseline packer vs new cascade bucketer across token-distribution traces (chat, summarize, search),
A/B on internal shadow traffic: measure pad tokens, throughput, per-bucket kernel utilization
Chaos tests that inject bursty arrivals and ensure no regression in OOM or scheduling latency
End-to-end regression against sample models (Llama-3 70B, RedWillow-13B) on A100 and H100
rollout_plan: Feature branch + integration tests merged to staging
Staging perf run and dashboard verification
Canary rollout: 1% of traffic for 24h, validate pad reduction and P99; if stable move to 10% for 12h
Increment to 50% and then 100% with automated rollback if P99 exceeds threshold or pad reduction regresses
Post-rollout: 48h observation window and retrospective write-up
risks: Overhead of per-request bucket computation could add CPU pressure on frontends; mitigate with sample-based histogram and bloom filters
Kernel hint expectations may cause suboptimal kernel selection if model/sequence distribution shifts rapidly
Aggressive packing could increase KV cache misalignment and cause decode slowdowns for long continuation requests
Fairness: high-throughput tenants might dominate bucket filling and delay small bursty latency-sensitive requests
comments: 2025-10-30: Spike completed comparing static quantiles vs adaptive cascade; adaptive cascade consistently reduces pad at tail by ~18-25% depending on workload mix. — Priya

2025-11-01: Implemented prototype packer + kernel_hint tags; initial end-to-end staging run shows 22% pad reduction but 3% CPU increase on frontends. Decided to add sampling mode to reduce compute. — Evan

2025-11-03: Design review with Runtime and Router teams. Router needs bucket id surface; agreed on compact 8-bit bucket id in envelope and advisory kernel_hint enum. Action: update request envelope spec. — Grace (Runtime lead)

2025-11-05: Performance tests with Llama-3 show no P99 increase when steering low-latency buckets to hot lanes. Added tests for KV cache alignment; found one case where partial merges cause cache thrash, added heuristic to avoid merging requests with >30% prefill mismatch. — Miguel
2025-11-06: Security review flag: ensure kernel_hint cannot be user-injected; enforced in gateway validation layer. QA to run smoke tests before canary. — Security
